name: airgap-anything
description: Agent skills for air-gapped environments: airgap-architect designs the system and lists what to carry in; airgap-transfer packs that list into a bundle that checks itself inside.

interface.longDescription: Two skills for networks without internet access. airgap-architect interviews you about your organization and writes a blueprint: one decision per layer with its reasons and alternatives, GPU sizing with every step written out, and the transfer manifest of everything to carry in, from a catalog where each version and image has its source. airgap-transfer turns that manifest into a bundle that checks itself: fetch commands you approve first, a SHA-256 list, a split across USB disks, a data diode or a staging host, and a runbook or agent rules for the inside. The skills are plain markdown: no scripts, no dependencies. They are a design aid, not professional advice: verify before you buy or deploy.
defaultPrompt: Design an air-gapped LLM platform for my organization.
How many GPUs do we need to serve a 70B model to 500 users on a network without internet?
Prepare everything in our transfer manifest for our USB disks.
